method.instrumentation: query hashes, ALS attribution and response SHA256 included in timings; observed modes add overhead
method.cpu: process batch CPU divided by completed calls; overlapping calls are not individually attributed
method.sqlTiming: client-observed duration includes pool wait and transport; overlapping queries are not additive wall time
method.percentile: empirical nearest rank; short local sample does not estimate production p99
method.components: real exported functions measured separately, not additive endpoint wall times
method.cpuProfileWorkload: 60 additional serial students.list page50 calls only
